name: Mildred Lee
bio: Richard Le Gallienne's first wife, who died in 1894 giving birth to their second daughter Maria, who died with her; their elder daughter Hesper Joyce survived. Le Gallienne afterwards carried an urn of her ashes with him everywhere, through his second marriage and beyond - a habit Rupert Brooke satirised in a poem, 'For Mildred's Urn'.
